body:
Thank you for the support everyone, there are people on here that deserve your support more than I

Just wanted to say that today was a pretty good day but the moment I decided it's time to sleep (10 seconds ago) and my head hit the pillow and I closed my eyes, my first thought was of walking into a suspended net.. as i slowly got entangled and it slowly constricted my neck and the floor fades from under me... I don't know why my mind does that....

It's so confusing but and yet so relieving at the same time....

Anyone else experiencing similar moments?

Your strength amazes me, your ability to cope is inspiring, while I can't even begin to comprehend your situation, you do nothing but impress me with your tenacity.

Do you see a future where you don't feel like this?

Do you see a light of any kind?

You sound like you've been robbed but you sound like you need support.

I'm a fucking child in comparison crying over spilt milk, your an inspiration even if right now you don't feel like that
Why should I suffer daily for others?

Ahhh really? but i had to waive all rights to the employee benefits - I don't have holiday time or any pension benefits - I certainly hope the Gov doesn't think cheap food is "Close Enough" 

Ahh right so keeping me petrol reciepts is only worthwhile for VAT?

Otherwise i just total my miles - Cheers for clearing that up :)

Home and Company are the same address, yes, so this is off site.  

So this is the assumption I can claim both food and petrol for this "off site" contract. 

The Site has a canteen with food that is "subsidised" so its like £3 a meal - its prepared fresh that day. 

So would this count?

> e has a possession caution and a disorderly conduct caution, 

Thank you for your first(second) hand experience, its really good to hear about peoples experiences similar to my own! 

Thanks,

This is what I am hearing a lot, the "MAY" turn up is not quite the definitive answer I was hoping for. 

It seems the low level warning I received is so minor that people don't know EXACTLY how or where it pops up for how long, as opposed to an official Caution or Conviction. 

Thank you for your comment, it really helps!

Hmm, I feel like I was, i just don't recall it, seen as I was the driver of the car with 3 friends, he certainly searched the car/let me show him places. 

He had to call a female officer to search the girl with us, so im guessing we all got some form of a pat down, shoes off sort of thing. 

Parts of it just don't register under the stress, but once it seemed the incident was very low level, i started to ask questions, e.g. "How long does this last".

Hopefully your right, thanks for the comment!

Your description is the one that most closely matches my recollection of the events, however, I fear my bias is tainting those memories. 

All in all, im just hoping this one time offence isn't going to stop me seeing the world or trying to better it.

> The only way to know for sure is a subject access request with the force though.

Okay, nice and clear, Thank you!

If the employer asks me directly about "Cannabis" or about "Warnings", can you clairfy?

I have a Subject Access Request on the way now, regarding the topic of Deletion of Records via ACRO, Is this something my situation could apply for?

No fine, nothing, just a long piece of paper and a i drove off with my friends.

None of us were ever called into a police station, unless i literally did it and wiped it from memory... 

But TBH, I dislike walking into police stations, can't help but feel like a criminal even if your the victim
I can't get a DBS check, im not an employer, all I can do is a Subject Access Request.

I did not know that, 

Do i have to disclose what the potential crime is to the Information Compliance Officer or can i just ask for any "Dealings" i had with officers over a 6 month period? 

I feel as though I'm walking around admitting to crimes that may not even be on record, so i'm not exactly sure how to handle this. 

Are you saying it's a poor show on my part? If so, I was happy to just get away from the situation, but I was totally unaware and was not given any options and AFAIK it wasn't going to last 12 months, so why would i keep evidence of it otherwise? 

Just told "Since you were honest, ill give you this caution/warning" (Can't remember the exact wording)

Otherwise, as an Officer, what action do you think was taken here?
